I'm glad you brought up food as well: Fast food prices have outpaced wages since 2024 and have nearly increased by 50% the last two years. We're about to see almost every major food service joint that's not multinational evaporate, undoing 80 years of consumer culture around American food.
Before you say "Why do I care about food despite the fact I just brought it up??" service jobs at fast food joints is where most of our jobs moved to after we gave everything away to China.
